notes: 781-site extraction via extract_site_aridity() (canonical snapshot, standard site filter — valid lat/long, distinct site_id). ai_value = raw_integer * 0.0001 per CGIAR v3.1. Ocean pixels (raw value 0) treated as NA; recovered via buffer/nearest-land fallback. unep_class_5: canonical UNEP 5-class (thresholds 0.05/0.20/0.50/0.65). unep_class_7: 5-class + FAO humid subdivisions at 1.0 and 2.0. Regenerated by scripts/generate_maps.R (Map10); same extraction function used by scripts/figure_representativeness_aridity.R.
